caption:
Asian Tadka Cucumber Salad 
yaar make tadka the normal way pls!!!

Ingredients: 
2 cucumbers, sliced, add a tsp of salt and leave for 20 minutes then drain out the water and set aside 
6 cloves garlic, minced
1 spring onions, chopped (greens only) 
1 tsp vinegar ( rice wine works best but regular does the job too)
1 tsp white esesame seeds
1 tsp red chilli flakes ( use korean chilli flakes for best flavour) 
1 tsp soy sauce
2 tsp sesame oil
